warmup: Dr. Nair here. Before we build a new trophy, take a toy apart. Lock in your prediction first. Then drag each part onto Scale 2. Watch both scales and the adding tape. Does anything go missing?
part1: Each sticker is a group. Drag Bends onto the rubber band. Does Waterproof fit too? Every card shows how many stickers it needs. A wrong sticker bounces off, so read why. The iron nail might surprise you.
part2: Engineers test before they build. Pick a job tab and read what it needs. Drag a material into the rig, then press Run the test. If it fails, swap and run again. Can steel win every job?
explore: Five swatches, two tests. Press Drip water and watch: does it bead up, or soak in? Then press Bend it. Tap what you saw. Your classification table fills in row by row. Read it at the end.
